name: prompt-1027
image_vibe: Playful red Santa-fashion swagger with forced perspective and bright commercial holiday energy
image_purpose: Create a festive vertical poster visual with a human subject and reindeer companion.

prompt.project_info: A full-body vertical 3:4 festive poster using the required approved-adult subject reference and one realistic reindeer.
prompt.main_subject: The person from the required approved-adult reference image as the only human subject; preserve the reference subject's gender presentation, face structure, hairstyle, skin tone, and overall likeness without gender swapping. Dress the subject in a rich red velvet Santa suit with clean white fur trim, Santa hat, white gloves, stylish black sunglasses, and modern clean white sneakers. Keep a grounded swagger power stance with both feet fully on the floor, arms firmly crossed, chin slightly raised, and a subtle confident smirk.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical 3:4 framing, subject center-left, camera-right reindeer fully visible, wide stance with the front sneaker closer to camera for mild forced-perspective enlargement while planted on the floor, bright red seamless backdrop with soft spotlight gradient, and metallic silver confetti floating throughout.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Crisp commercial studio lighting with clean texture separation, bright festive red environment, sharp detail on velvet, fur trim, knit scarf, reindeer fur, and sunglasses, playful swagger mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Low-angle 20-28mm wide-lens look from near knee height with a slight upward tilt, mild depth of field, photorealistic poster rendering, high-resolution 4K-style detail, no text, watermark, logo, or brand mark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body vertical 3:4 festive poster using the required approved-adult subject reference as the only human identity reference. Preserve the subject's gender presentation, face structure, hairstyle, skin tone, and overall likeness without gender swapping. Pose the subject in a grounded swagger power stance with both feet fully on the floor, feet apart, weight mostly on the back leg, the front sneaker planted closer to camera for mild forced-perspective enlargement, knees slightly bent, hips subtly cocked, upper body slightly leaned back, shoulders rolled back, arms firmly crossed over the chest, chin slightly raised, slight head tilt, and a subtle confident smirk. Dress the subject in a rich red velvet Santa suit with clean white fur trim, Santa hat, white gloves, black sunglasses, and modern clean white sneakers. Place one realistic full-body reindeer on camera-right with prominent antlers, a cute curious look, and a cozy red-and-green knitted scarf. Use a bright red seamless studio backdrop with a soft spotlight gradient, metallic silver confetti, crisp commercial lighting, detailed velvet, fur trim, knit scarf, reindeer fur, and sunglasses, a low-angle 20-28mm wide-lens look from near knee height, mild depth of field, photorealistic 4K-style clarity, and no text, watermark, logo, or brand mark.
